1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
     2	"""Fresh CPU/CUDA prerequisites, optionally followed by the frozen six-dataset pilot."""
     3	import argparse
     4	import json
     5	import os
     6	import re
     7	import shutil
     8	import sys
     9	from pathlib import Path
    10	from cpu_gpu_protocol import PROTOCOL, ROOT, dump_new, load_protocol, require, sha, verify_source_extension
    11	from run_cpu_gpu_pilot import invoke
    12	from validate_cuda_sort import verify_result
    13	from non_timing_tests import selected_ctest
    14	
    15	def main():
    16	    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,allow_abbrev=False)
    17	    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    18	    parser.add_argument('--pilot-output',type=Path)
    19	    parser.add_argument('--processed',type=Path)
    20	    parser.add_argument('--prerequisites-only',action='store_true',help='Only audited non-timing correctness prerequisites; never pilot/study; not full study authorization')
    21	    args=parser.parse_args();output=args.output.absolute()
    22	    if not args.prerequisites_only and (args.pilot_output is None or args.processed is None):
    23	        parser.error('--pilot-output and --processed are required unless --prerequisites-only')
    24	    try:output.mkdir();(output/'commands').mkdir()
    25	    except OSError as error:print(error,file=sys.stderr);return 1
    26	    try:
    27	        model=load_protocol();before=verify_source_extension(model)
    28	        dump_new(output/'source_review.json',before)
    29	        build_root=ROOT/'build'/output.name
    30	        build_root.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    31	        require(not build_root.exists(),'build output already exists');build_root.mkdir()
    32	        cpu=build_root/'cpu-release';san=build_root/'cpu-sanitize';gpu=build_root/'gpu-release'
    33	        commands=output/'commands';records={}
    34	        def call(name,argv,timeout=900):
    35	            result=invoke(commands,name,argv,timeout)
    36	            records[name]=dict(file='commands/'+name+'.json',sha256=sha(commands/(name+'.json')))
    37	            return result
    38	        call('preflight',[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'scripts/cuda_preflight.py'),'--output',str(output/'preflight'),'--timeout-seconds','180'],240)
    39	        probe=json.loads((output/'preflight/report.json').read_text())
    40	        require(probe['classification']['device0_kernel_verified'] and probe['classification']['state']=='operational','fresh kernel preflight failed')
    41	        device=next(d for d in probe['runtime_probe']['devices'] if d['ordinal']==0)
    42	        require(device['name']=='Tesla T4' and (device['compute_major'],device['compute_minor'])==(7,5),'wrong GPU for frozen protocol')
    43	        common=['cmake','-S',str(ROOT),'-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=','-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS_RELEASE=-O3 -DNDEBUG','-DMAB_ENABLE_OPENMP=ON','-DBUILD_TESTING=ON']
    44	        call('cpu_release_configure',common+['-B',str(cpu),'-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release','-DMAB_ENABLE_CUDA=OFF','-DMAB_ENABLE_CPU_GPU_COMPARISON=OFF'])
    45	        call('cpu_release_build',['cmake','--build',str(cpu),'--parallel','2'])
    46	        if args.prerequisites_only:
    47	            result=selected_ctest(call,output,'cpu_release_ctest',cpu)
    48	        else:
    49	            result=call('cpu_release_ctest',['ctest','--test-dir',str(cpu),'--output-on-failure','-V'],900)
    50	            require('0 tests failed out of 29' in result['stdout'],'CPU regression coverage mismatch')
    51	        call('cpu_sanitize_configure',common+['-B',str(san),'-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug','-DMAB_ENABLE_CUDA=OFF','-DMAB_ENABLE_CPU_GPU_COMPARISON=OFF','-DMAB_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=ON'])
    52	        call('cpu_sanitize_build',['cmake','--build',str(san),'--parallel','2'])
    53	        try:
    54	            prefix=['env','-u','ASAN_OPTIONS','-u','LSAN_OPTIONS','UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1']
    55	            if args.prerequisites_only:
    56	                result=selected_ctest(call,output,'cpu_sanitize_ctest',san,prefix=prefix)
    57	            else:
    58	                result=call('cpu_sanitize_ctest',prefix+['ctest','--test-dir',str(san),'--output-on-failure','-V'],900)
    59	        except RuntimeError:
    60	            record=json.loads((commands/'cpu_sanitize_ctest.json').read_text())
    61	            text=record['stdout']+record['stderr']
    62	            require('LeakSanitizer does not work under ptrace' in text,'unrelated sanitizer failure; stop before pilot')
    63	            prefix=['env','ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0','UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1']
    64	            if args.prerequisites_only:
    65	                result=selected_ctest(call,output,'cpu_sanitize_ctest_no_leaks',san,prefix=prefix)
    66	            else:
    67	                result=call('cpu_sanitize_ctest_no_leaks',prefix+['ctest','--test-dir',str(san),'--output-on-failure','-V'],900)
    68	            records['cpu_sanitize_ctest']=records['cpu_sanitize_ctest_no_leaks']
    69	            dump_new(output/'LEAK_LIMITATION.json',dict(reason='LeakSanitizer does not work under ptrace',original_record='commands/cpu_sanitize_ctest.json'))
    70	        if not args.prerequisites_only:require('0 tests failed out of 29' in result['stdout'],'sanitizer coverage mismatch')
    71	        call('cuda_configure',common+['-B',str(gpu),'-DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release','-DMAB_ENABLE_CUDA=ON','-DMAB_ENABLE_CUDA_SORT=ON',
    72	            '-DMAB_ENABLE_CPU_GPU_COMPARISON=ON','-DMAB_ENABLE_SANITIZERS=OFF','-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=75',
    73	            '-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS=','-DCMAKE_CUDA_FLAGS_RELEASE=-O3 -DNDEBUG'])
    74	        cache=(gpu/'CMakeCache.txt').read_text()
    75	        include=Path(next(line.split('=',1)[1] for line in cache.splitlines() if line.startswith('MAB_CUB_INCLUDE_DIR:PATH=')))
    76	        dependency={str(p.relative_to(include)):sha(p) for name in ['cub','thrust','cuda'] for p in sorted((include/name).rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
    77	        require(bool(dependency),'empty CUB dependency manifest')
    78	        dump_new(output/'dependency_sha256.json',dict(include_root=str(include),files=dependency))
    79	        call('cuda_build',['cmake','--build',str(gpu),'--parallel','2'],1200)
    80	        correctness=call('cuda_correctness',[str(gpu/'test_cuda_sorting')],240)
    81	        result=verify_result(json.loads(correctness['stdout']))
    82	        if args.prerequisites_only:
    83	            ctest=selected_ctest(call,output,'cuda_ctest',gpu,allow_gpu=True)
    84	        else:
    85	            ctest=call('cuda_ctest',['ctest','--test-dir',str(gpu),'--output-on-failure','-V'],900)
    86	            require('0 tests failed out of 32' in ctest['stdout'] and '***Skipped' not in ctest['stdout'],'CUDA regression group skipped/missing')
    87	            require('Ran 14 tests' in ctest['stdout'],'GPU framework coverage absent')
    88	        after=verify_source_extension(model);require(before==after,'source changed during prerequisite validation')
    89	        prereq=dict(schema_version=1,protocol=PROTOCOL,complete=True,records=records,source_sha256=after['current_source_sha256'],
    90	                    binary_sha256=sha(gpu/'cpu_gpu_comparison'),input_tool_sha256=sha(gpu/'comparison_input'),
    91	                    cuda_correctness=result,preflight_sha256=sha(output/'preflight/report.json'),dependency_manifest_sha256=sha(output/'dependency_sha256.json'),
    92	                    validation_scope='non_timing_correctness_v1' if args.prerequisites_only else 'full_protocol_v1',
    93	                    study_eligible=not args.prerequisites_only)
    94	        dump_new(output/'PREREQUISITES.json',prereq)
    95	        if args.prerequisites_only:
    96	            dump_new(output/'COMPLETE.json',dict(complete=True,prerequisites_passed=True,pilot_run=False,full_study_run=False,
    97	                validation_scope='non_timing_correctness_v1',study_eligible=False))
    98	            return 0
    99	        call('pilot',[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'scripts/run_cpu_gpu_pilot.py'),'--output',str(args.pilot_output.absolute()),
   100	             '--executable',str(gpu/'cpu_gpu_comparison'),'--input-tool',str(gpu/'comparison_input'),
   101	             '--prerequisites',str(output/'PREREQUISITES.json')],420)
   102	        args.processed.absolute().mkdir()
   103	        first=args.processed.absolute()/'summary.json';second=args.processed.absolute()/'summary_regenerated.json'
   104	        for name,path in [('analyze',first),('regenerate',second)]:
   105	            call(name,[sys.executable,str(ROOT/'scripts/analyze_cpu_gpu.py'),str(args.pilot_output.absolute()),'--output',str(path)])
   106	        require(first.read_bytes()==second.read_bytes(),'summary regeneration differs')
   107	        raw=args.pilot_output.absolute();manifest=json.loads((raw/'RAW_SHA256.json').read_text())
   108	        require(all(sha(raw/p)==h for p,h in manifest.items()),'raw changed during analysis')
   109	        load_protocol();require(verify_source_extension(model)==before,'source changed during pilot')
   110	        dump_new(output/'COMPLETE.json',dict(complete=True,pilot_passed=True,full_study_run=False,measured=150,warmups=30,
   111	                 summary_sha256=sha(first),summary_regenerated_identically=True,source_unchanged=True))
   112	        return 0
   113	    except KeyboardInterrupt:
   114	        dump_new(output/'INTERRUPTED.json',dict(complete=False));return 130
   115	    except Exception as error:
   116	        dump_new(output/'FAILED.json',dict(complete=False,error=str(error)));print(error,file=sys.stderr);return 1
   117	if __name__=='__main__':raise SystemExit(main())
